# teams_template_permission_policy (Resource)

Manages the TemplatePermissionPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsTemplatePermissionPolicy / Get-CsTeamsTemplatePermissionPolicy / Set-CsTeamsTemplatePermissionPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsTemplatePermissionPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `hidden_templates` (String) Maps to the -HiddenTemplates parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
